doc: Strict-gate exceptions (migration Stage 5 step 2, README §7 W3). Since 2026-10-12 the vendor and conformance gates FAIL every module (make foundry-<m>-check, make foundry-modules-check). The only way a failing fail-class rule passes the gate is a row here: module id → rule id → {reason, decision, until, match}. `match` lists regexes (re.search) for the findings the decision covers: a failing finding no pattern matches blocks the gate, so a row never accepts a later, unreviewed finding of the same rule. Every row names the decision that accepted it (an Open-for-Joe row with Joe's decision, or a parked step) and what retires it. The gate also FAILS on a stale row — a listed rule that no longer fails — so this list cannot outlive its reason: when the work in `until` lands, delete the row in the same commit. Never add a row to make a red gate green without a decision to cite; fix the module instead. The vendor gate has no exceptions.
